name: St. Louis Post-Dispatch editorial board
lean_basis: Largest Missouri daily (Lee Enterprises). Still endorses: it ran primary endorsements in July 2026 (including 'State Auditor Fitzpatrick has earned GOP re-nomination'). Historically endorses mostly Democrats statewide; AllSides rates the news Lean Left. General-election endorsements are paywalled and were not readable in this pass.

name: League of Women Voters of Metro St. Louis (VOTE411)
lean_basis: Nonpartisan; the League never endorses candidates. Runs the St. Louis-area VOTE411 guide with candidate answers (personalized ballot needs a street address). No positions on these local measures were found as of Oct. 16.

name: The Missouri Bar Judicial Performance Review Committee (YourMissouriJudges.org)
lean_basis: Committee of lawyers and non-lawyer citizens run by The Missouri Bar, the statewide association all Missouri lawyers must belong to. It reviews only judges facing retention under the nonpartisan court plan and publishes a majority recommendation for each; it takes no part in partisan races or ballot measures. In 2026 it recommended retaining every judge it reviewed.
